column1: You can use `process.env` to access [Environment Variables](/docs/app/building-your-application/configuring/environment-variables) for both `next dev` and `next build`.
The Edge Runtime has some restrictions including:
- Native Node.js APIs **are not supported**. For example, you can't read or write to the filesystem.
- `node_modules` _can_ be used, as long as they implement ES Modules and do not use native Node.js APIs.
- Calling `require` directly is **not allowed**. Use ES Modules instead.
The following JavaScript language features are disabled, and **will not work:**
